items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: He's a good friend of George all my young life. I played gigs with George.

ctx.x: But what about George Lutz? Did you have an album here?
Oh, George, sure. I know George. He's a good friend of George all my young life. I played gigs with George. I know George. Yes, indeed.
Where did you play the gigs with George?

items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: I remember once George Lewis played there for a while

ctx.x: Played a little drum. You remember, you used to call this place the, you know the Dream Room? Yeah. They had another man for it, and Mr. Johnny had it.
Oh yeah, I can't think now. I remember once George Lewis played there for a while and then a band from Dayton, Ohio was now.
